notes.title: Hide Time: Chapter 1 - New patch + content! (version 1.1.2)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! :D
Here's another patch for the game!

Besides fixing some reported issues we also added some new requested content!
Here's the list:

-Added collectibles! (There are 5 in total. To view them you need to press "C" while playing the game)
-Added option to disable camera shake
-Improved the flashlight (It won't be so bright anymore upon close contact with any objects)
-Fixed bugged voice line from John after finishing the plunger task
-Made some UI fixes
-Improved performance a bit

These are all the changes! We hope you will like this new patch! :D
From other smaller news - we are planning to release the entire Chapter 1 soundtrack later this month!
That's all for now!
See you all next time!

-Midnight Games Team

notes.title: Hide Time: Chapter One - BIG UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
After so many weeks of work, we finally finished the big update for Hide Time: Chapter One!
We took into a count all your feedback while making this update and we hope you will like how it turned out!
Lots of improvements, changes and even some new content!
The whole team is very thankful for all your amazing support! We can't wait to bring you more projects in the future!
Now go and enjoy the update!!! :D
Much love for you all!



Hide Time: Chapter One Update - List of changes:

New content/Additions:

-Added a small side activity (throwing rocks at the lake)
-Added a new interaction with a coffee machine (Drinking coffee gives the player a small speed boost for a limited period of time)
-Added 3 new locations
-Added new notes
-Added new posters and art
-Added new objects and models to further improve the level design (new types of boxes, DJ plush, pipes, etc.)
-Added new secrets
-Added some easter-eggs
-Added a new line for John
-Added an option to turn off the objectives
-Added an option to fully delete the save file (hold "DEL" in the main menu for 3s)
-Added a bug report function (it can be found in the settings)
-Added a new item pick up sound
-Added new dust and water particles
-Added new sounds for DJ Cat (walking sounds)
-Added new sounds to the main and pause menus (sounds for clicking and hovering the buttons)
-Added second jumpscare variant for DJ Cat
-Added support for arrow keys (for walking)
-Added various new sounds effects around the game
-Added notifications about new files and emails in the John's computer (once a player gets a new file, a dot will appear in John's computer. Either above "files" or above "mail")

Improvements and changes:

-Overhauled the game settings panel (added resolution scale, socials tab and improved the mouse settings)
-Overhauled the animations for DJ Cat
-Overhauled the interactions system (it should work on any hardware now and it works far better now)
-Greatly improved the optimization
-Improved the notes (you can now pick them up for easier reading)
-Improved the level design by adding more detail
-Improved the water materials
-Improved the resolution settings
-Improved the player movement
-Improved the game flow at the Lobby (the key quest should not be so confusing anymore)
-Improved the dust particles
-Improved the UI
-Improved the physics for the boxes in the sorting minigame
-Made the subtitles more readable
-Made the game a bit more spooky
-Made the survey accessible in the game settings
-Gave proper titles to the songs on John's computer
-Did a lot of general improvements to the game's code
-Did many other smaller changes

Bug-fixes:

-Fixed many softlocks (water softlock in the Lobby and couch softlock in the Cozy Corner - just few examples)
-Fixed the missing collisions for computers after interacting with them
-Fixed the interface for the sorting minigame
-Fixed the issues with constant stuttering
-Fixed the crouching (you can no longer get stuck when you uncrouch)
-Fixed the settings not saving sometimes
-Fixed the saving system not always saving all the progress
-Fixed some clipping models around the levels
-Fixed missing collisions
-Did some other tiny fixes and improvements



Showcase of few of the changes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207276/7702031f967fe0d90418781a9ad2917692fb9de8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207276/dd9866a79151c7a175dad3ca6ed0fd1be9bc6d1a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207276/f92047f1dd8e8bffe05205fbbba42a08f4690f67.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207276/6236cba20f613013243f92343b543b5e4f2d3a24.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207276/2f9ef2ecd839cd1625dee6e58833758fa4953345.gif[/img]

Once again thank you all for your great support! :D
Have a great weekend!

-Midnight Games Team

notes.title: Hide Time - Patch 8 (version 1.0.8)
notes.content:
We got more reports about the problems with picking up the first key.
This patch should help more people with this problem.

Fixes and changes:
-fixed the entrance key (it should work for more people now)*
-changed the final objective to "RUN! Get to the security office" to make it more clear where to go
-done some polish around the map of the game

*We want to dive into this issue more in the future. For now one of the solutions it to lower the settings in the game. Weak performance may cause issues. If it doesn't help go to properties of the game in your Steam library and in the run options type a command - "-dx11" to switch the game to DirectX 11. If you own an older system it can help with the performance and hopefully with the entrance key bug.

Once again thank you for your reports! We hope to fix this issue once and for all!
-Midnight Games Team

notes.title: Hide Time - Patch 2 (ver 1.0.2)
notes.content:
Hello!
Here's another patch for the game!

Here's the list of bugs which got fixed:

-fixed spamming the sound of jumping,
-fixed credits not working for everyone after finishing the game (it should work for everyone now),
-fixed doors clipping into the wall in Cozy Corner Coffee,
-fixed weird collisions in the warehouse area,
-fixed the chase sequence with DJ Cat (now you will always die when he catches you),
-fixed the settings menu showing incorrect information (for example - You have "Low" settings and you get a message that it is "Epic"),
-fixed the water sound being played after the chase.

In case you notice any other bugs report them to us! :D
Besides that - thank you for a great reception of the game so far!
Thank You and keep having fun with the game!
-Midnight Games Team
